story.titleZh: 哈斯车队车手分享对拉斐尔感受及赛季目标
story.summaryZh: 哈斯车队车手表示自己曾两次为车队参赛，对拉斐尔的情况有所了解，强调团队合作以在赛季末期为车队争取积分。

story.originalTitle: "I’ve raced for the team here twice already, subbing in for Kevin in 2024, so I know a little about how Rafa will be feeling. The focus is to work to...
story.summaryEn:
"I’ve raced for the team here twice already, subbing in for Kevin in 2024, so I know a little about how Rafa will be feeling. The focus is to work together to get some points for the team as we head into the business end of the season." 🗣️ OB
Looking ahead to the weekend in São Paulo 🇧🇷
#HaasF1 #F1 #BrazilGP
detailZh:
“我已经为这个车队比赛过两次了，2024年代替凯文参赛，所以我对拉法会是什么感觉有一些了解。我们的重点是共同努力，在赛季的关键阶段为车队赢得一些积分。” 🗣️ OB
展望本周末在圣保罗的比赛 🇧🇷
#哈斯F1 #一级方程式 #巴西大奖赛
detailEn:
"I’ve raced for the team here twice already, subbing in for Kevin in 2024, so I know a little about how Rafa will be feeling. The focus is to work together to get some points for the team as we head into the business end of the season." 🗣️ OB
Looking ahead to the weekend in São Paulo 🇧🇷
#HaasF1 #F1 #BrazilGP
